title: 第809章 这怎么就不算做好事呢？
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

要真让缘空回忆，那么他好似只见过尊佛如难一次，还是楚星尘要他假扮光明佛陀去忽悠尊佛。

那一日的如难好似已经看穿了，只是没有揭穿罢了。

就这样一面之缘也不知道算哪门子的老熟人。

缘空也并未真信楚星尘找的接头人真是如难，毕竟如难身为佛门唯一的尊佛，寻常见一面都难，那会有空真来亲自带他做什么意义不明的联动。

顶多就和楚星尘一样，找个挂个名号的佛修来凑数。

楚星尘八成就是故意夸大说辞来开自己玩笑，想看他紧张不已的表情。

所以缘空应得干脆，反正说不去也是不太可能，倒不如应得干脆，至少显得自己还有些魄力，也不会让楚星尘真看了笑话，要不然这些年的凡尘历练岂不是白练了。

楚星尘也并未废话，只是笑着点头夸了句——好小子长进很大。

当缘空被楚星尘带着穿梭而行，再远远的瞧见佛门祥云，看见了森罗宝盖，看见了眼眸半闭的如难，看见了架势极大的佛门阵势之后……

“等等……等等……”缘空目光瞪大的连忙开口，“你认真的吗？真的是如难尊佛吗？”

楚星尘看着前方的如难回答道：

“我说了你又不信，你到时候问他不就知道了。”

“慢……慢点飞。”缘空心中有些哆嗦的开口道，“上次不是都跟他们真干起来了吗？以他修为肯定勘破了我的真身，我上次可听你的话忽悠过他。”

“对啊，怎么了吗？”

“就算我是个便宜弟子，你也不能真把我卖给如难吧？而且我还修了点大乘佛法，万一被他们拆了怎么办？”

“人家是尊佛，怎么会记仇，更何况你这个倒霉佛子拆了能换什么东西来。”

“万一他给我穿小鞋怎么办。”

“他可是尊佛，格局很大的。”

“尊佛格局就大吗？那我还是佛子呢，不也没什么格局。”

“你成了尊佛格局就大了，你好好混，指不定将来你就是尊佛了。”

“我长大了，没当年那么傻了，我也知道现在修大乘佛法的和尚别说当尊佛了，就是去大雷音寺门口没被抓都算走狗屎运了。”

楚星尘身形不停，嘴角勾笑道：

“哦？那你现在是什么都明白了，有什么要说的吗？”

缘空绷着脸一本正经道：“能不能换个倒霉和尚？”

Page (1/3)

If Yuan Kong really recalled it, then it seemed that he had only seen the Buddha Runan once, or that Chu Xingchen wanted him to pretend to be the Buddha of Light to deceive the Buddha.

Ru Nan seemed to have seen through it that day, but it was not exposed.

I don't know what kind of old acquaintance they are even though they met just once.

Yuan Kong didn't really believe that the contact person Chu Xingchen was looking for was really Ru Nan. After all, Ru Nan was the only Buddha in the Buddhist sect and it was difficult to meet him. Then Kong Zhen would personally lead him into some unknown linkage.

At most, just like Chu Xingchen, find a Buddhist cultivator with a name to make up the numbers.

Chu Xingchen probably exaggerated the words deliberately to make a joke on himself, wanting to see his nervous expression.

So Yuankong deserves it simply, and it is impossible to say it anyway. It is better to deserve it simply, at least it will show that he has some courage, and Chu Xingchen will not really laugh at it, otherwise all these years of mortal experience will be in vain.

Chu Xingchen didn't talk nonsense, he just smiled and nodded and praised - the good boy has grown a lot.

When Yuan Kong was led by Chu Xingchen, he saw the auspicious clouds of Buddhism from a distance, saw the Senluo Baogai, saw Ru Nan with half-closed eyes, and saw the huge Buddhist formation...

"Wait...wait..." Yuankong opened his eyes and said quickly, "Are you serious? Is it really Runanda Buddha?"

Chu Xingchen looked at Ru Nan in front of him and replied:

"You don't believe me when I tell you. You'll know if you ask him then."

"Slow... fly slowly." Yuan Kong said with some trembling in his heart, "Didn't we really fight them last time? With his cultivation, he must have discovered my true identity. I listened to your words and deceived him last time."

"Yeah, what's wrong?"

"Even if I am a cheap disciple, you can't really sell me to Runan, right? Besides, I have also practiced some Mahayana Buddhism. What if they dismantle me?"

"I respect Buddha, how can I hold grudges? What's more, you, the unlucky Buddha, can't get anything in exchange for it if you tear it down."

"What if he gives me little shoes?"

"He respects the Buddha and has a great structure."

"Is the pattern of respecting the Buddha big? Then I am still a disciple of Buddha, so there is no pattern."

"If you become a Buddha, your status will be great. If you mix well, you may become a Buddha in the future."

"I've grown up, and I'm not as stupid as I was back then. I also know that monks who practice Mahayana Buddhism nowadays, let alone become Buddhas, are just lucky if they don't get caught at the gate of Daleiyin Temple."

Chu Xingchen kept moving and said with a smile:

"Oh? So now you understand everything, do you have anything to say?"

Yuan Kong said solemnly with a sullen face: "Can you change to an unlucky monk?"
